1 room available in a 1 bedroom 1 bathroom unit. Apartment is furnished but the available room is not. Unit includes central AC/heating, washer / dryer in unit. There is a private bathroom located in the hallway right outside of the room. Amenities include a recently renovated gym, 2 pools, a hot tub, grilling areas and a clubhouse that is available for reservations if you like to host! Street parking and guest parking is available. Water charge and trash valet is included in rent, PGE and internet will be paid separately (roughly $70 - $90 a month)
Move in cost will be rent ($1225) and deposit (250) for a total first month of $1475. Usually payment will be $1225 per month (this number may change as lease renewal is coming up soon, but usually only changes by about $50).AVAILABLE NOW. Office space for an individual looking for a convenient 400 sq ft office space in the Mixed Use-Light Industry/offices District in Berkeley
Bright, Professional Office Suite in the Heart of West Berkeley
Beautiful private office located just two blocks from Fabulous 4th Street, Restaurants, Coffee Cafes, Shopping, Apple Store and downtown Berkeley area. Ideal for therapists, coaches, consultants, wellness practitioners, writers, or creatives seeking an inspiring professional space.
Features include:
• Private office
• Abundant natural light
• Artistic and professional environment
• Dedicated parking space
• Convenient Berkeley location
• Suitable for in-person client meetings or focused solo work
$600 includes all utilities. (Bay Alarm, exterior video cameras, Unwired internet, PGE, EBMUD, Waste Management)
THE SPACE:
Exceptional natural light: large industrial windows
Open plan layout accommodating lounge seating and workstation(s)
Private entrance, private bathroom and sink
LOCATION and LOGISTICS:
One dedicated off-street parking spot included (rare in this neighborhood)
Steps from 4th street shops, dining.
Easy access to I-80/580 and a short bike ride to North Berkeley BART
Don't miss this opportunity....
* This is not a live/work building *
* Motor vehicle storage or repair is prohibited *
* No live music or music rehearsal *
* No personal services activities*
* Cannabis-based businesses are prohibited *
To schedule a showing, reply with a brief description of your business and desired move-in date. If you contact us via Craigslist please give us your phone number so we can call you back.

Experience exceptional San Francisco living from this stunning 3-bedroom home perched directly on the historic Broadway Steps. Enjoy breathtaking, unobstructed views of Coit Tower, the Bay Bridge, and the Transamerica Pyramid, with abundant natural light throughout the multi-level layout. The home features one private ensuite bedroom, two additional bedrooms with a shared full bathroom, and a dedicated in-unit laundry area. Located in the heart of walkable Russian Hill, with convenient street parking typically available nearby. No smoking; tenants are responsible for all utilities. Please leave your name, phone number, preferred move-in date, and a little about yourself for a faster response
1 Year Lease. Renter is responsible for utilities.

Family home available for sublet in sunny Bernal Heights while we are travelling. We are seeking subletters who will enjoy our home and take care of it. Perfect for families, individuals, and couples of all ages. Our house is filled with character, with expansive views of downtown and the city, and would be most enjoyed by artistic individuals who appreciate creative architecture. The main floor includes a beautiful kitchen and living room, multiple bedrooms, a bathroom, and office space. The downstairs levels include additional sleeping areas, bathrooms, and a spacious family room. We are located on a flat street with a wide sidewalk, accessible on foot to all amenities. Serious inquiries only.

3-bedroom, 1.5-bath single-family home in Bernal Heights, approximately 1,600 sq ft. Private backyard, one compact-car parking space in the garage with full garage access, and brand-new washer, dryer and dishwasher.
Main level includes living room, dining room, eat-in kitchen, one bedroom and full bath. Upstairs are two large bedrooms, including one with an en-suite half bath.
Conveniently located near Cortland Avenue's restaurants, shops and bars, as well as the Bernal Heights Library, Community Center and Rec Centers. Close to Bernal Heights Park. Convenient to the 24, 67, 14 and 49 Muni lines, 24th St BART, and 101/280. Managed by owner.
Rent: $7,750/month
Available: August 31
Lease: 12 months
Utilities: Tenant pays all utilities
Parking: 1 compact car in attached garage
Laundry: Private In-Unit
Outdoor space: Private backyard
Pets: Considered
Furnished: No
Photos are from a previous staging. Floors of final bedroom were retouched using AI as floors are currently being repainted. Home will be shown and offered unfurnished.
12-month lease. Tenant responsible for all utilities. Pets considered with owner approval. No smoking. Renters insurance required.
To apply, please email back with information about the members of your household, desired move-in date, and all the 15 minute time slots you are available to tour within the current 2 tour dates: Tuesday 8/18 from 5:15pm to 6:30pm and Thursday 8/20 from 5:15pm to 6:30pm. We will email back with the confirmed time slot.

2262 Filbert Street, San Francisco, CA 94123
Beautifully remodeled top-floor 5-room Victorian flat in the heart of Cow Hollow, one of San Francisco’s most desirable and walkable neighborhoods. Occupying the top floor of an intimate 3-flat Victorian building, this spacious residence combines classic San Francisco character with extensive modern updates. The top-floor location provides excellent natural light, privacy, and a wonderful residential feel.
Property Highlights:
•	Top-floor 5-room Victorian flat
•	Newly remodeled throughout
•	Beautiful hardwood floors
•	High ceilings and abundant natural light
•	Classic Victorian architectural details
•	Spacious formal living room
•	Separate formal dining room
•	Flexible rooms for bedrooms, home office, or guest room
•	Remodeled bathroom
•	Updated kitchen with new appliances
•	In-unit washer and dryer
•	Recessed lighting and modern finishes
•	Excellent Cow Hollow location
•	Near Union Street, Chestnut Street, Marina District, restaurants, cafés, shopping, parks, and public transportation
•	Street parking only — no garage parking included
Rent: $8,295 per month
Term: 12 months lease
Deposit: $8,295.00
Utilities: Tenant pays 1/3 water; PG & E, Gas, Cable TV and Internet
Renters insurance is required upon signing lease agreement
Enjoy the charm and generous proportions of a classic San Francisco Victorian with the comfort of a newly remodeled interior. The flexible 5-room floor plan is ideal for those looking for additional space for working from home, entertaining, or creating a comfortable guest room.
Tour Schedule:
Monday to Friday: 5:30PM - 8PM
Saturday and Sunday: 2PM
